messages:
sophia (SE): Hey team — quick async sync on JUNO enterprise pilot. Linking the acceptance checklist: https://redwood.docs/juno/checklist

sophia (SE): Key dates: integration dry-run 2025-09-15, UAT handoff 2025-09-22, go/no-go 2025-09-29. Need owners for: VPC peering, SSO SAML config, model pin+quantization, throughput tests.

kyle (PM): noted. I'll own timeline and stakeholder comms. @mike can you pick up VPC peering? who on infra?

mike (Eng): I can take VPC peering. ETA: initial peering setup + firewall rules by EOD 9/10, testing finish by 9/14. blocking: customer network team needs our IP ranges (sent earlier) — do we have their CIDR?

elaine (Solutions Eng): I have the CIDR from Juno; sending to @mike in dm. Also PR for connector updates is ready: https://github.com/redwood/connector/pull/512 — needs code review + e2e test run.

nora (QA): I'll schedule smoke tests against staging after connector PR merges. Can we get a stable model version pinned? need deterministic outputs for acceptance tests.

mike (Eng): model pin: we'll serve gpt-open-3b-v2-quant on staging. I'll add rollout config in infra repo. PR coming ~9/11.

sophia (SE): Success criteria for Juno: latency p95 < 350ms for 1k qps sim, embedding quality A/B within 3% of baseline, zero PII leakage in 50 test prompts. Please add these to checklist.

elaine (Solutions Eng): Added metrics to checklist. Also asking legal for DPA sign-off — queued with legal@. No blocker yet.

mike (Eng): Quick CR ping — @elaine can you review the connector PR for header propagation? it's one small change but affects auth flow.

elaine (Solutions Eng): On it. Will review today.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging-juno-v1 at 2025-09-12T03:00:00Z. Triggered by mike. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/juno/123

nora (QA): If staging deploy succeeds we can run smoke+regression 9/12 and full load 9/14.

sophia (SE): One more ask: can we get a short runbook for on-call during dry-run? maybe 1 pager: who to call for infra, support, and se.

kyle (PM): I'll draft the runbook and share by 9/11.

mike (Eng): FYI — if peering delayed, fallback plan is we run through dedicated tunnel (higher latency) for 48h. I'll add config to ops playbook.

elaine (Solutions Eng): Reviewed connector PR, left minor comment about header tests. Approving after test update.

nora (QA): QA note: need to whitelist Juno test IPs for webhook callbacks — sending ticket to eng-infra.

sophia (SE): Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a blocker ping here. :thumbsup: 

kyle (PM): quick check: who is owning post-mortem if dry-run fails? assigning owner ahead: @kyle.

mike (Eng): ack.
